description.value: Across the Creek Cabins is a family-operated property consisting of four self-contained cabins on 10 acres of private land at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park, roughly 25 km from downtown Clearwater. Each open-concept studio cabin is fully equipped with a kitchen, queen bed, sofa-bed, three-piece bathroom, and a private outdoor patio overlooking forested surroundings. The property has deep roots in the Smith family going back to the 1970s and sits just off the main road to Helmcken Falls, making it a convenient base for exploring one of BC's premier wilderness parks.
